import os,re,json
d=os.path.normpath(os.environ['RLM_SESSION_DIR'])
t=open(d+'/../../sessions/'+os.path.basename(d)+'.jsonl').read().replace('\\n','\n')
G={}
for m in re.finditer(r'(Demo pair \d+ (?:input|output)|Test input) \((\d+)x(\d+)\):\n',t):
    k,h,w=m[1],int(m[2]),int(m[3])
    rows=[r.split() for r in t[m.end():].split('\n')[:h]]
    if k not in G and all(len(r)==w and all(x.isdigit() for x in r) for r in rows):
        G[k]=[[int(x) for x in r] for r in rows]
def f(inp):
    o=[r[:] for r in inp]; H=len(inp); W=len(inp[0])
    ones=[(i,j) for i,r in enumerate(inp) for j,x in enumerate(r) if x==1]
    ones.sort(); sp=ones[1][0]-ones[0][0]
    for s in range(sp,H-sp,sp):
        if s+sp<H and s+sp<W: o[s+sp][s+sp]=2
    return o
print(f(G['Demo pair 1 input'])==G['Demo pair 1 output'], f(G['Demo pair 2 input'])==G['Demo pair 2 output'])
print(json.dumps(f(G['Test input'])))
